import json,sys
a=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));b=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))

PY
python3 -B $R/plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-source-lineage.py --repo-root $R; echo lineage_exit=$?; ls -la .dev-graph/state 2>&1; git status --porcelain
